about: Where in the player's own Fallout: New Vegas install the mod reads from (nothing from New Vegas is shipped). Each row becomes one FnvSource struct.

columns.id: source id, referenced by code (music_pools uses 'music', radio_songs 'songs', radio_dj 'voices')
columns.path: path under the New Vegas folder
columns.inner: folder inside the archive (bsa only), else ''
columns.usedBy: the sheet that reads from it
